subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

13, 27, 56, 115, 234,?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Next term = (Previous term × 2) + Consecutive natural number

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95fd687f812abc9cfe48d304be4322711309c852f226e3cae6d6b38c86961deb.png] 

Hence, "473" will replace the question mark (?) in the given series**.**
